about: Transmissions as real tower and ground controllers say them (FAA JO 7110.65 / ICAO Doc 4444 / CAP 413 forms: callsign first or last, 'heavy', grouped numbers, wind and runway first, trailing traffic info). 'say' is what the speech model writes; 'expect' is the callsign (airline code + number) and the game action.
